records.name: Archon
records.held_by: A harbour authority and merchant council in the East Empire Company's old buildings, with the successor state's customs officers alongside
records.summary: Archon is the province's best working harbour and its principal legal port, on the Padomaic coast where an estuary meets the sea. Amphibious civic life is ordinary here: children play underwater, guar breathe water, cargo moves above and below the surface. A sealed Shadowscale school stands closed in the town.

notes.text: A major port city on the eastern coast, marsh to the north and beaches to the south, beside an estuary that leads inland. It is the province's principal legal port and the south-east end of the Archon, Lilmoth, Soulrest and Tear trade line. Anyone arriving by sea or by the bayou channels passes through its harbour.

Founded as an Ayleid town by the Barsaebic exiles, on ground held earlier by the Lilmothiit and the Cantemiric Velothi. Its coast was full of pirates in the late First Era until General Lucinia Falco chartered them with letters of marque. The East Empire Company ran its wharves until the secession, and the Shadowscales kept a school here that closed in 4E 187. Umbriel in 4E 48 never reached it.

records.name: Lilmoth
records.held_by: A reconstituted merchant council; no ruler
records.summary: Lilmoth is the Festering Jewel of Black Marsh, destroyed in 4E 48 and rebuilt smaller as a wholly Argonian stilt town over a mass grave. Its Old Imperial quarter lies drowned and unrepaired. A young Hist grows in the lower town. It is feared and tended under a rotating guard of tree-minders.

notes.text: A merchant port on the southern point of the Althii islands, built over shallow water so large ships anchor out and lighter their goods in. It is the biggest town on the south coast and the market for the delta villages and estates of the Althii islands.

Founded by the Lilmothiit, ruled by Priest-Kings and taken by the Empire; its Imperial Quarter was looted when the An-Xileel drove the Empire out at the secession. Its second Hist grew mad and summoned Umbriel in 4E 48, and the Slaughter at Lilmoth destroyed the city. The site was resettled in the generations after, because the harbour has no rival nearby.

notes.text: Rebuilt but not restored: smaller, lower and wholly Argonian in its fabric. The merchant council sets the dock tolls and pays the guards. notes.text: The third Hist is walled but open, tended by two minders at once and no faction may hold exclusive access. A sunken shrine to Xhon-Mehl the Fisher, the Ancestral Organ Lord of Lilmoth, is known to divers.

Ninety percent of the fabric is Argonian stilts and platforms that climb into the air, wired together by walkways, over a drowned layer of Imperial villas. Old Imperial walls survive in places; mould, vines, big bamboo, sleeping palms and harmless drifting shines mark the drowned quarter.

The streets and walkways are safe, guarded by the council's men, though slaughterfish swim the canals. Smugglers hold the drowned Imperial cellars under Pusbottom. The drowned Imperial quarter and the Hist's roots are dangerous, with sea-drakes in the deep water beyond.

records.summary: Uluo is the one town of the Three Waters Tribe, on the north shore of the Althii islands facing the Nushara Bayou. It is the seat of the tribe's elder and the market where the bayou hamlets sell rice, shellfish and reed. The tribe deals with Archon as an equal and with Lilmoth by the back-water routes.
